label: copy-phase input k, late in long sequences, when the next output is k or w
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and almost only when the fed-back input token is k (99.9% of activation mass). Nearly all of it falls on steps t >= 13 (recall_idx 4-8), i.e. long sequences (L=8-9 hold 99% of the mass). Within those, it fires mostly when the token being output is w or k, i.e. the original sequence had k followed by w or k (94% of mass); out_tok a appears with weaker activations. Larger t / later recall position goes with higher firing rate (lift rises from 2x at t=13 to 20x at t=16). It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, and never on other inputs (aside from 3 tiny w activations). Precision is limited: many k->w/k steps at t=13-14 do not fire, so the late-position condition is only approximate.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=k (+3.81), in_tok=k (+3.27), phase=2 & out_tok=w (+3.04), out_tok=w (+2.97), phase=2 & out_tok=k (+2.64), out_tok=k (+2.58). Lower it: correct=1 (-4.95), orig7=- (-1.81), recall_idx=3 (-1.77), orig8=- (-1.53).
